## What's new
- **A new model to download: Ornith 1.5 35B-A3B OptiQ 4-bit with the Ornith team's draft model.** On an M5 Mac, code arrives about a third sooner and essays about a tenth sooner than with the plain OptiQ build, and every word is still the model's own. The DFlash2 build of the same model stays quicker; this one takes about 0.7 GB less disk. - **`astronomical unload`** frees the loaded model's memory from the terminal. It refuses while a reply is being written. - **See whether a draft model is helping:** - `astronomical status` says whether the loaded model drafts (or why not) and how many guessed words the last reply kept. - Observatory's Models page notes the models that carry a draft model. - Programs see the same figures in `/v1/status`, and in OpenAI chat usage as `accepted_prediction_tokens` and `rejected_prediction_tokens`. - **Models you copy, move or remove by hand show up within seconds,** with no restart. A copy still in progress is listed once it has finished.
## Fixes
- A model folder moved by hand no longer fails to load with "selected model family could not be classified".
## For agents
The Astronomical skill now explains draft models, what to do when a model copied in by hand does not appear or a model fails to load for lack of memory, and the drafting figures in the local API.
## Compatibility
Your models, conversations and settings carry over unchanged. Astronomical 0.2.133 is signed with a Developer ID certificate and notarized by Apple.
